<svg class="draw" viewBox="0 0 620 300" role="img" aria-labelledby="f1-t" aria-describedby="f1-d">
          <title id="f1-t">Two panels comparing market response to second-party and third-party corporate wrongs</title>
          <desc id="f1-d">Left panel: for each dollar of value inflated by misrepresentation, the firm loses 36 cents to legal and regulatory penalties and 2 dollars 71 cents to reputational loss, totalling 3 dollars 7 cents — a reputational penalty 7.53 times the legal one. Right panel: the abnormal share price reaction to a third-party wrong is plus 0.24 percent, statistically indistinguishable from zero, shown against a scale reaching 3 percent.</desc>

          <!-- ---- PANEL A ---- -->
          <text class="tk-lab" x="0" y="12" font-weight="650">Second-party wrong</text>
          <text class="tk" x="0" y="28">Misrepresentation · loss per $1 of value inflated</text>

          <!-- scale: $0 at x=0, $3.20 at x=300  → 93.75px per dollar -->
          <g>
            <!-- gridlines -->
            <line class="gridln" x1="0" y1="44" x2="0" y2="150"/>
            <line class="gridln" x1="93.75" y1="44" x2="93.75" y2="150"/>
            <line class="gridln" x1="187.5" y1="44" x2="187.5" y2="150"/>
            <line class="gridln" x1="281.25" y1="44" x2="281.25" y2="150"/>
            <text class="tk" x="0" y="164" text-anchor="middle">$0</text>
            <text class="tk" x="93.75" y="164" text-anchor="middle">$1</text>
            <text class="tk" x="187.5" y="164" text-anchor="middle">$2</text>
            <text class="tk" x="281.25" y="164" text-anchor="middle">$3</text>

            <!-- legal 0.36 → 33.75px -->
            <rect class="m-solid" x="0" y="58" width="33.75" height="30" rx="3"/>
            <!-- 2px surface gap between stacked segments -->
            <rect class="m-priced" x="35.75" y="58" width="254.06" height="30" rx="3"/>

            <!-- direct labels -->
            <line class="leader" x1="16.9" y1="94" x2="16.9" y2="108"/>
            <text class="tk-val" x="16.9" y="122" text-anchor="middle">$0.36</text>
            <text class="tk" x="16.9" y="136" text-anchor="middle">legal</text>

            <line class="leader" x1="162" y1="94" x2="162" y2="108"/>
            <text class="tk-val" x="162" y="122" text-anchor="middle">$2.71</text>
            <text class="tk" x="162" y="136" text-anchor="middle">reputational</text>

            <text class="tk-lab" x="0" y="192">Reputation takes</text>
            <text class="tk-big" x="0" y="218">7.53×</text>
            <text class="tk" x="0" y="236">what law and regulators take</text>
          </g>

          <!-- divider between panels: these are separate instruments -->
          <line class="gridln" x1="345" y1="0" x2="345" y2="270"/>

          <!-- ---- PANEL B ---- -->
          <g transform="translate(380,0)">
            <text class="tk-lab" x="0" y="12" font-weight="650">Third-party wrong</text>
            <text class="tk" x="0" y="28">Abnormal share-price reaction</text>

            <!-- scale: 0% at x=0, 3% at x=210 → 70px per percentage point -->
            <line class="gridln" x1="70" y1="44" x2="70" y2="150"/>
            <line class="gridln" x1="140" y1="44" x2="140" y2="150"/>
            <line class="gridln" x1="210" y1="44" x2="210" y2="150"/>
            <text class="tk" x="0" y="164" text-anchor="middle">0%</text>
            <text class="tk" x="70" y="164" text-anchor="middle">1%</text>
            <text class="tk" x="140" y="164" text-anchor="middle">2%</text>
            <text class="tk" x="210" y="164" text-anchor="middle">3%</text>

            <!-- zero line -->
            <line class="zeroln" x1="0" y1="44" x2="0" y2="150"/>

            <!-- the measured effect: 0.24% → 16.8px. Drawn at true width. -->
            <rect class="m-harm" x="0" y="58" width="16.8" height="30" rx="3"/>

            <line class="leader" x1="16.8" y1="73" x2="52" y2="73"/>
            <text class="tk-val" x="58" y="70">+0.24%</text>
            <text class="tk" x="58" y="85">not significant</text>

            <text class="tk-lab" x="0" y="192">The market was told a firm</text>
            <text class="tk-lab" x="0" y="209">injured a stranger, and</text>
            <text class="tk-big" x="0" y="238">heard nothing.</text>
          </g>
        </svg>
fs-ns1.cap: What the market prices, and what it does not

<svg class="draw" viewBox="0 0 620 345" role="img" aria-labelledby="f6-t" aria-describedby="f6-d">
          <title id="f6-t">The Vioxx interval and the Boeing penalty apportionment</title>
          <desc id="f6-d">A safety panel counted excess cardiac events in November 1999; the drug was withdrawn in September 2004, an interval of nearly five years during which an estimated 20 million Americans took it, with later Lancet estimates of 88,000 heart attacks and 38,000 deaths, and a 4.85 billion dollar settlement in 2007. Separately, of Boeing's over 2.5 billion dollar resolution, 1.77 billion went to airline customers as compensation, 243.6 million was the criminal penalty, and the remainder is not itemised in this record.</desc>

          <!-- timeline -->
          <g>
            <text class="tk-lab" x="0" y="14" font-weight="650">The interval</text>
            <line class="axisln" x1="30" y1="70" x2="560" y2="70"/>
            <line class="zeroln" x1="30" y1="52" x2="30" y2="88"/>
            <line class="zeroln" x1="560" y1="52" x2="560" y2="88"/>
            <rect class="aperture" x="30" y="52" width="530" height="36"/>
            <text class="tk-val" x="30" y="44">Nov 1999</text>
            <text class="tk" x="30" y="106">79 of 4,000 with serious cardiac</text>
            <text class="tk" x="30" y="119">events or death, against 41 on</text>
            <text class="tk" x="30" y="132">the older drug</text>
            <text class="tk-val" x="560" y="44" text-anchor="end">Sept 2004</text>
            <text class="tk" x="560" y="106" text-anchor="end">Withdrawn</text>
            <text class="tk-big" x="295" y="78" text-anchor="middle">4 years, 10 months</text>

            <text class="tk" x="295" y="156" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:var(--text-primary);font-weight:650">~20 million Americans took it · est. 88,000 heart attacks, 38,000 deaths · $4.85 bn settled, 2007</text>

            <line class="gridln" x1="0" y1="180" x2="620" y2="180"/>

            <!-- boeing apportionment -->
            <text class="tk-lab" x="0" y="204" font-weight="650">The apportionment</text>
            <text class="tk" x="0" y="220">346 people died in two crashes less than five months apart.</text>
            <text class="tk" x="0" y="233">Headline resolution: “over $2.5 billion.”</text>

            <!-- 100% = 2.5bn over 560px from x=30 ; 2px surface gaps between segments -->
            <rect class="m-priced" x="30" y="250" width="396.5" height="30" rx="3"/>
            <rect class="m-ink" x="428.5" y="250" width="106.9" height="30" rx="3"/>
            <rect class="m-harm" x="537.4" y="250" width="52.6" height="30" rx="3"/>

            <line class="leader" x1="228" y1="282" x2="228" y2="294"/>
            <text class="tk-val" x="228" y="308" text-anchor="middle">$1.77 bn</text>
            <text class="tk" x="228" y="322" text-anchor="middle">to the airlines that bought the planes</text>
            <text class="tk" x="228" y="335" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:var(--priced);font-weight:650">counterparties</text>

            <line class="leader" x1="482" y1="282" x2="482" y2="294"/>
            <text class="tk" x="482" y="308" text-anchor="middle">remainder</text>
            <text class="tk" x="482" y="321" text-anchor="middle">not itemised here</text>

            <line class="leader" x1="563" y1="246" x2="563" y2="238"/>
            <text class="tk-val" x="590" y="234" text-anchor="end">$243.6 m</text>
            <text class="tk" x="590" y="220" text-anchor="end" style="fill:var(--harm);font-weight:650">the criminal penalty — under a tenth</text>
          </g>
        </svg>
